lead_fa: Blood یک تانک خوددرمان‌گر است که بیشترِ بقا و آسیبش را از مدیریت Runic Power و [[Death Strike]] می‌گیرد. در Midnight و پچ 12.1.5 دو مسیر Hero Tree پیش روی توست: [[San'layn]] برای ریید و [[Deathbringer]] برای Mythic+؛ این صفحه بیلد، روتیشن، گیر و مصرفی‌های هر دو را جمع کرده است.

hero.recommendation: San'layn back on the menu for everything at level 90 with full Apex talents + Death Strike buff; particularly strong single-target and up to 5-8 consistent targets; new tier set amplifies it further.

deathbringer.pitch: Significantly easier to play, defensive advantages, very good choice for Mythic+ specifically.
deathbringer.kit: Revolves around [[Reaper's Mark]] (45s cd, or 30s with a talent) with hooks tied to its application and expiration; minor burst tied to Dancing Rune Weapon.
deathbringer.defense: Near-permanent 7.5% damage reduction buff, doubled Blood Plague healing (Rapid Decomposition interaction), Permafrost tie-in from Exterminate damage, cooldown reduction on Lichborne.
deathbringer.note_12_1: Numerically ahead where it matters per Icy Veins; gained complexity through Echoing Fury; Soul Reaper removed which removed some clunk.

sanlayn.pitch: Best throughput for raid single target and 5-8 targets; recommended default for raids.
sanlayn.kit: Commits to using [[Dancing Rune Weapon]] rotationally (90s cd) to build and keep stacks of [[Essence of the Blood Queen]]; [[The Blood is Life]] funnels and duplicates Shadow damage at the end of the window.
sanlayn.defense: Small bonus Mastery, shield on you and your target when you resurrect somebody, party leech buff while Lichborne active or Icebound Fortitude cooldown reduction, optional 5% physical damage reduction via Blood-Soaked Ground.
sanlayn.note_12_1: Nerfed: Frenzied Bloodthirst to 5% per stack, Visceral Strength to 10% strength; lost end-of-DRW Infliction of Sorrow burst; redesigned Consumption adds complexity (cast after DRW ends); Heart Strike buffs without matching Vampiric Strike buffs push it further down per Icy Veins.

hero.comparison_source_note: Both sources agree: San'layn = raid/ST throughput (Wowhead) while Icy Veins currently leans Deathbringer numerically; both agree Deathbringer = easier + M+ pick.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Blood Death Knight Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/death-knight/blood/talent-builds-pve-tank), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts_wowhead: Manage buffs and debuffs: positional (Death and Decay), throughput checks (Ossuary), rotational checks (Hemostasis), maintenance buffs (Coagulopathy).
Keep cooldowns on cooldown: Dancing Rune Weapon is loaded with defensive and offensive value; delaying it wastes those effects.
Optimize resources: Death Strike is bread and butter both offensively and defensively; maximize its use.
principles_icyveins: Generate Runic Power by spending runes and maximizing Heart Strike usage.
Spend Runic Power on Death Strike without wasting any (no overcap).
Press Death Strike before Hemostasis stacks beyond 5.
Use Death and Decay when Crimson Scourge procs or when cleaving 4+ targets.
Dancing Rune Weapon and Reaper's Mark are the two main offensive cooldowns; keep them as close to on cooldown as possible.
priority.resource_frame: Runic Power generated by rune-spending strikes (Heart Strike); runes regenerate over time (Haste scales it). Marrowrend is the Bone Shield maintainer but is a damage loss versus Heart Strike when Bone Shield is safe.
priority.new_midnight_tool: Consumption is now an empower spell: consumes up to 75% of remaining damage on plagues to heal you; San'layn redesign wants it cast after Dancing Rune Weapon ends.

gearing_rules: On pieces with Strength (all non-jewelry and trinkets), item level gains outweigh most secondary stat choices.
On jewelry and at equal item level: San'layn favors Haste, Deathbringer aims to avoid it.
Use Raidbots Top Gear to evaluate sidegrades; the exact gearset being BiS does not make each piece individually optimal.

tier_set.note: The new Midnight Season 2 tier set amplifies the San'layn playstyle (Wowhead).

stats.note_wowhead_cheatsheet: San'layn: str >> haste >= crit >= mastery = versatility. Deathbringer (M+): str >> crit >= mastery = versatility > haste; raid variant listed crit = mastery = versatility > haste.
stats.primary_note: Strength is primary; ilvl upgrades on Strength pieces beat secondary stat choices.

mplus.hero_note: Deathbringer is the very good choice for Mythic+ (easier play, defensive advantages) per Wowhead; Icy Veins agrees.
tips: Blood's defensive toolkit: Anti-Magic Shell (immune most magic debuffs and curses), Lichborne (Charm/Fear/Sleep immunity), Icebound Fortitude (Stun immunity), Death's Advance (knockback immunity).
Group utility: Anti-Magic Zone, Death Grip, Gorefiend's Grasp; two separate taunts (Dark Command, Death Grip); Blinding Sleet AoE disorient on a very short cooldown; Purgatory uncapped cheat death.
Limited mobility baseline: Death's Advance; Death's Echo gives a second charge, Wraith Walk is the alternative talent.

defensive_buffs: Rapid Decomposition: leeches 85% more from Blood Plague
Umbilicus Eternus: accumulates 20% more (health cap unchanged)
Bloodshot: now grants 4% damage reduction while active
Perseverance of the Ebon Blade: changed to provide 4% damage reduction
nerfs: Frenzied Bloodthirst: reduced to 5% per stack
changes_12_1.world_scaling: 12.1 defensive buffs account for the 25% world scaling.

strengths: Unique group utility: Anti-Magic Zone, Death Grip, Gorefiend's Grasp
Lichborne: temporary immunity to Charm, Fear, Sleep; Icebound Fortitude for Stuns
Anti-Magic Shell immune most magic debuffs and curses
Two separate taunts: Dark Command and Death Grip
Blinding Sleet: AoE disorient on a very short cooldown
weaknesses: Limited mobility: Death's Advance baseline; augmentations via Death's Echo or Wraith Walk
Tuned around taking higher damage upfront and healing back; newcomers misread it as unavoidable one-shots
Significantly reduced defensive cooldown choice versus previous expansions

concepts: Manage buffs and debuffs: Bone Shield (bonus armor + Runic Power cost reduction), Hemostasis (amplifies self-healing), Death and Decay standing buff, Ossuary, Coagulopathy.
Keep cooldowns on cooldown: Dancing Rune Weapon and all defensive cooldowns are the bread and butter of the spec.
Optimize resources: spend Runes to convert them into Runic Power efficiently; more Runic Power = more Death Strike.
rotation.rp_rule: Cast Death Strike if you need the healing or are above 75 Runic Power (Wowhead's measured breakpoint: keeps two Death Strikes available and prevents overcapping at 45 RP = two to three full Heart Strikes).
rotation.bone_shield_rule: Maintain at least 5 charges of Bone Shield; if it is about to expire, press Marrowrend. As Deathbringer, every 45s two Exterminate charges guarantee a refresh; if 8+ bones, Death Grip works as an effective refresh (Death's Caress if taunting is not possible).

rotation.aoe_note: AoE does not fundamentally change the broad priority; emphasize fully empowering Consumption and be stricter about Death and Decay uptime. AoE openers are the same as single target but with a gather phase first (weave Blood Boil / Heart Strike / Death Strike for threat, pre-place Death and Decay at the end of the gather).
opener_deathbringer_st: While Death's Caress is in flight, pre-place Death and Decay
Spend one Exterminate charge via Marrowrend
opener_sanlayn_st: While Death's Caress is in flight, pre-place Death and Decay (primes Blood Plague ahead of Dancing Rune Weapon so the first Blood Boil pandemics it)
rotation.drw_details: Dancing Rune Weapon: 30% parry for 12s, replicates Heart Strike, Marrowrend, Blood Boil and Death Strike; Marrowrend during it grants 3 bonus Bone Shield per active weapon; Blood Boil during it makes each weapon apply its own Blood Plague copy; talents add 5% parry for the first 8s and up to 10 Runic Power per second for the first 8s. San'layn uses it as the main activator of its Hero Talent window.
rotation.bone_shield_advanced: Bone Shield needs one generator every 30s. Deathbringer with Reaper's Onslaught handles it automatically; with Dark Talons, delay one Exterminate explosion by ~5s or slot Death Grip to refresh the full stack. San'layn has no passive generation and Apex talents randomize Marrowrend charges (each Apex Dancing Rune Weapon adds 3 stacks) - track it with UI.
pre_combat: Raid: check consumables - flask, food, augment rune, temporary weapon oils/whetstones at all times.
M+: Bone Shield persists between pulls while time remains; Runic Power decays 1 RP/s out of combat; refresh Bone Shield at the end of a pull and pool RP for the next pull.
M+ key start: Bone Shield charges stay and up to 25 Runic Power remains; hit target dummies before the key starts to prepare both resources.
